title_patterns_that_work: I Checked If [Brand] Is A Scam... (The Truth)
Is [Brand] Legit or a [Topic] Scam? (The Real Ratings)
Is [Brand] Actually Legit? (I Checked The Data)
title_patterns_to_avoid: Technical jargon hooks like 'Installing a TLS Backdoor'
Vague qualifiers like '(Mixed Reality)' or '... (What I Found)'
Targeting obscure micro-niche tools and apps with low search demand (e.g., Ax-check.com, WalkEarn)
Weak imperative sign-offs like 'Don't Buy Yet'
notes: Shorts heavily outperform long-form content on this channel (top 5 performers are all Shorts reaching 90-335 views). Content explicitly framing brands around consumer skepticism or scam alerts ('Cashify Is A Scam', 'StubHub Scam', 'Sweatcoin Legit') drives 4x-12x channel median, whereas hyper-technical security or low-demand payout apps consistently stall under 15 views.
